raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 12 (349 rows, exactly the 349 `source_tz='UTC'` rows) has txn_ts in UTC, but silver_transactions treats every txn_ts as local time. Those rows are shifted about 6 hours early, which pushes 00:00-06:00 local-looking timestamps into 2026-01-17 and inflates that day's volume. Converting UTC rows to America/Chicago before deriving txn_date should fix silver and the gold tables that read from it.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN (txn_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' ELSE txn_ts END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN (txn_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' ELSE txn_ts END AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
